item: ТЗ-97 Q4 in this commit: ТЗ-87 G3 — KSPI's 20-F payload carries both taxonomy sections, and the parser used to keep only dei when any us-gaap tag was present, so every ifrs-full row was dropped. Fix: taxonomies are now a per-payload list (us-gaap + ifrs-full, dei last), priority stays per-concept through _IFRS_RANK_OFFSET, and _latest_canonical ties equal end dates by rank so the pass is deterministic.
step: Q4 verified on evidence, not inference: live payload CIK0001985487 has us-gaap 2 tags / 4 rows against ifrs-full 152 tags / 1015 rows, so the old filter threw away 99.6% of the reporting section (VALE the same at 43 ifrs rows in the r3 fixture). 2 of the 5 allowed requests spent. Numbers on a copy of the user catalogue (P7, as_of 2026-09-28): 617 236 -> 628 380 facts, ifrs-full 10 329 -> 21 473; KSPI 31/0 -> 36/11, BHP 34/2 -> 40/22, VALE 39/15 -> 39/14 (the anchor moved 2012-12-31 -> 2025-12-31, two old debt/capex inputs became stale_data), VOD 34/0 unchanged. Batch 277 passed / 4 xfailed in 113.96s, plus 12 new teeth in tests/test_task97_q4_ifrs_ingest.py. Disputed 19-23: the old G4 xfail tooth left intact, KSPI capex only under a forbidden lookalike, gross_margin refusing a fact while the derived gross_profit is valued, pe/ps with no K6 currency check (pre-existing at US-AMX), and KSPI reporting_currency USD over KZT facts. Next in TASK-97 order: Q12 rows 2 and 7. Acceptance caught one defect of mine on check 11 (без zstandard): the run crossed midnight, `rusterm add` stamps ticker_history.valid_from = today, and the fixture pinned as_of 2026-09-28 — so the sandbox lost its ticker one day later («у 'US-KSPI' нет тикера на 2026-09-28», 6 setup errors, verdict 12/1, no commit). The gzip fallback was not the cause. Fixed in the fixture: the sandbox declares the listing valid from 2015-01-01 through add_ticker_history, so the teeth no longer depend on the day they run; re-verified 12 passed with zstandard blocked (0.37s) and normally (0.44s), numbers unchanged.
